about: Dated status summaries for the original DOS titles' OTHER route: the release's own Windows DOSBox.exe running inside the Win98 emulator. The DOS payloads, file manifests and ToyVM assessment come from test/toyvm-dos-corpus/manifest.json; runs, screenshots and tasks are read live. A summary older than the latest run is flagged on the dashboard.

daggerfall.label: Dungeon movement reviewed (DOSBox route only)
daggerfall.summary: Ordinary forward/reverse movement and stable idle were personally reviewed in the first dungeon after the required-save manifest repair. Native ToyVM gameplay remains unverified. No FPS, audio or sustained-play claim.

arena.label: Dungeon controls reviewed (narrow)
arena.summary: A fresh character reaches the first dungeon; turn and reverse inputs change the view and an idle wait is stable, personally reviewed. No frame rate, sound or long-play claim.

ultima4.label: Overworld movement reviewed (narrow)
ultima4.summary: After character creation the original save overlay lets the game reach the overworld; arrow keys move the party, reviewed. No frame rate, sound or long-play claim.

shadow-warrior.label: Command line only
shadow-warrior.summary: No browser registration. Through the command-line runner the bundled DOSBox shows the startup banner (automated test); a manual probe recorded in the notes reached first-person play, with its screenshot outside the repository.

gta1-demo.label: Payload only
gta1-demo.summary: No DOSBox wrapper ships with the demo and no route runs it; only its package hashes are checked (test/test-dos-game-corpus.js).

extraRows.title: DOS demoscene gallery (199 productions)
extraRows.label: Runs on ToyVM in its own gallery
extraRows.summary: ToyVM's proven ground: the gallery page runs these productions with its own Run button; per-production status is in docs/dos-corpus-blockers.md. It is a static site the ops gateway does not serve, so there is no launch link here.
